journey.name: Memory Leak Check - Search Surface
journey.description:
Verifies that running search queries, switching result sub-tabs (Posts, People, Feeds), and opening/popping search result detail screens does not retain ViewModels or search state.
Executes 3 loop iterations with theme switches (dark/light) to trigger Activity recreation while observing LeakCanary output.

actions.action: Tap the Search tab on the main navigation bar
Verify that search bar and search screen are visible
Type search query into the search input field and submit search
Verify that search results are displayed
Tap the People tab in search results
Verify that account results are visible
Tap the Feeds tab in search results
Verify that custom feed results are visible
Tap the Posts tab in search results
Tap the first search result item to view details
Verify that the detail screen is visible
Press the system back button to return to search results
Verify that search results are visible
Switch the device to dark theme
Switch the device back to light theme
Repeat all of the steps above two more times
Press the Home button to send the app to the background, then wait 15 seconds for LeakCanary analysis
Verify that no LeakCanary leak notification appears except for known accessibility delegate semantics cache
